name: format-fields
description: test.md 'war3map.w3c v3: whether the u32 after the name' and 'war3map.w3e water-bits' (2026-11-17, SD): format-fields.w3x (tests/fixtures/we-specs/make-format-checks.mjs fields) opened and saved, no edits. Cameras Alpha..Delta with trailer 0, 1, 2, 7: the editor saves 0, 1, 1, 1 and its script has BlzCameraSetupSetCameraType 0, 1, 1, 1 (the camera type; Studio's file keeps 2 and 7, its script writes 1). Doodads with preFlags 0 and 7, roll and pitch floats, a placement id 100 and lights: the editor keeps them, and gives the lamp post without a light (doodads[6]) its model's one. Water bit 15 on 25 corners: the editor clears it (Studio keeps the word)

name: format-missing
description: test.md 'A genuinely missing model id' (2026-11-17, SD): format-missing.w3x (make-format-checks.mjs missing), a doodad of the unknown id Xzz1 and a unit of the unknown id xzz1 beside a tree and a footman. The editor draws neither (no cube, nothing), writes 'Invalid object ID: Xzz1' twice in its view's message lines, and leaves both out of its save. Studio draws its checkered cube for them and keeps them (a save never drops data): the known difference is the two lists

name: format-doodad-props
description: test.md 'The 3.0 doo fields preFlags, trailer and extras' (2026-11-17, SD): format-doodad-props.w3x (make-format-checks.mjs props). The editor: the lamp post's Doodad Properties (d, a click on its pole, Return, its General tab: the dialog opens on the tab used last), Roll 15, Pitch 30, then its Lights tab, Light 1: Intensity 7, Shadow Start 20, Shadow End 40, Quadratic 3, Linear Falloff 2, Damping 1, OK. Studio writes the values those names stand for into war3map.doo.json: trailer [id, roll, pitch] in radians, the light [0, Casts Shadows, Color, Intensity, Shadow Start, Shadow End, Quadratic x 0.0001, Linear Falloff x 0.01, Damping x 0.000001] (the editor's float products: 3 x 0.0001 is 966609233, one below 0.0003's)

steps.eval: const p = 'map/war3map.doo.json'; const doc = JSON.parse(await w3.workspace.readText(p)); const d = doc.doodads[0]; if (d.id !== 'LOlp') throw new Error('doodads[0] is ' + d.id); const f = (x) => { const v = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(4)); v.setFloat32(0, x, true); return v.getUint32(0, true); }; d.trailer = [d.trailer[0], f(15 * Math.PI / 180), f(30 * Math.PI / 180)]; d.extras = [[0, 1, 0xff102030, f(7), f(20), f(40), 966609233, f(0.02), f(0.000001)]]; await w3.workspace.writeText(p, JSON.stringify(doc, null, 1));
